name: MTDC Raigad Fort-Top Restaurant
area: Raigad fort summit, near MTDC cottages
signature_dish: Pre-ordered Maharashtrian thali at the Maratha capital
why_it_matters: The only sit-down restaurant on Raigad Fort summit — MTDC-run, attached to the semi-luxury cottages where you can stay overnight at the Maratha capital. Food must be ordered in advance (kitchen has to procure ingredients via the ropeway). The unique experience of dining at the seat of Chhatrapati Shivaji's coronation in 1674.
insider_tip: Phone the MTDC desk before climbing — order at the ropeway base by 10am for a 1pm fort-top lunch. The MTDC cottages require advance booking; food-only walk-ins also need pre-order. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Raigad Fort summit, Mahad taluka, Raigad 402301

name: Raigad Fort-Top Village Chulha Kitchen
area: Raigad fort summit, traditional village homes
why_it_matters: Village families living atop Raigad fort cook traditional Maharashtrian veg + non-veg meals on chulha (wood-stove) at fixed rates set by the local committee. On arrival at the summit, a designated villager-spokesperson asks if you want to order; rates are set, no haggling. The most authentic post-trek lunch in Maharashtra fort tourism.
insider_tip: Eat in the family courtyard, not by the cliff — the wind blows away food. Rates are fixed per the village committee — confirm before ordering. Cash only. Best mid-afternoon (1-2:30pm) when the kitchen is hot.
signature_address: Raigad Fort summit village, Mahad taluka, Raigad 402301

name: Pachad Base Eateries (Ropeway Foothill)
area: Pachad village, Raigad Fort ropeway base
why_it_matters: At the Pachad ropeway base, ample parking and a cluster of small village eateries serve fresh local food — misal pav, vada pav and pithla-bhakri are the standard pre-climb and post-descent orders. Useful for travellers who don't want to commit to the MTDC pre-order or the fort-top village kitchen.
insider_tip: Eat lightly before the ropeway/climb (misal pav can be heavy); save the pithla-bhakri for descent. Cash only; sturdy walking shoes essential. The 4pm last ropeway down means lunch on the fort, snacks at the base.
signature_address: Pachad village, Raigad Fort ropeway base, Mahad taluka, Raigad 402301
